title: RAG (Retrieval‑Augmented Generation) Project
description: This project implements a retrieval‑augmented generation (RAG) pipeline that enables a model to answer user queries by retrieving relevant chunks of text from a custom knowledge base and then generating responses grounded in that context. It uses Python for document ingestion/chunking, embeddings (semantic vector representation), a vector store for retrieval, and a language model for generation. The workflow demonstrates how to combine retrieval + generation for more accurate, context‑aware Q&A and assistant capabilities.
